modern: When you have been forced by circumstances to be disturbed in some way, quickly return to yourself, and do not stay out of tune longer than the compulsion lasts; for you will have more mastery over the harmony by continually returning to it.
original: When thou hast been compelled by circumstances to be disturbed in a manner, quickly return to thyself, and do not continue out of tune longer than the compulsion lasts; for thou wilt have more mastery over the harmony by continually recurring to it.
